clues.it: Ugo era nella 9ª colonna, accanto a un gargoyle e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 9th column, beside a gargoyle and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Carla era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a una torcia e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Carla was in the 5th column, beside a torch and in a different room from Olga.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un tappeto e nella stessa stanza di Carla.
clues.en: Luca was beside a rug and in the same room as Carla.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 2ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a una libreria.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 2nd column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a bookcase.

clues.it: Dario era nella 5ª riga, accanto a una libreria e a nord di Rosa.
clues.en: Dario was in the 5th row, beside a bookcase and north of Rosa.

clues.it: Irene era nella 4ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e a nord di Giada.
clues.en: Irene was in the 4th column, in the 6th row and north of Giada.

clues.it: Rosa era a nord di Elena e in Biblioteca.
clues.en: Rosa was north of Elena and in the Library.

clues.it: Olga era a nord di Giada e nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Olga was north of Giada and in the Kitchens.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 12ª colonna e nella 9ª riga, ma non era accanto a un'armatura.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 12th column and in the 9th row, but was not beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Sergio era l'unica persona su della paglia e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Sergio was the only person on a bed of straw and west of Dario.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 8ª colonna, nella 12ª riga e nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Elena was in the 8th column, in the 12th row and in the Dungeon.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: Fabio può stare solo nella 12ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 12th column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 5th, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a un trono» non torna senza Giada: deve stare in riga 11ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a throne” cannot add up without Giada: they must be at row 11th, column 1st.
